product_launches.description: Quicknode announced the "next evolution of Quicknode," positioning it as a complete Web3 development platform that provides node access, real-time data streams, webhooks, and dedicated clusters for builders across more than 77 chains and 130 networks.

overview_description.description: QuickNode is a blockchain infrastructure platform that supplies developers and enterprises with tools to build, scale, and maintain Web3 applications. It offers APIs and access endpoints (RPC/REST/WebSocket) across 60+ blockchains and 100+ networks, including full-node and archive-node options depending on the use case. The platform includes developer-friendly features such as Streams for real-time data delivery, Functions (serverless edge code) to respond to on-chain events and transform blockchain data without managing infrastructure, QuickAlerts / Webhooks for being notified of smart contract events, and a Marketplace of add-ons and tools to extend functionality.

about_short_description.short_description: #1 Blockchain Infrastructure Platform. Learn, Build, and Scale Onchain.

product.name: Core RPC API
product.description: Managed, low-latency blockchain node access across 83+ chains and 140+ networks, including full and archive data for reading chain state and submitting transactions.

product.name: Dedicated Clusters
product.description: Private, isolated blockchain infrastructure for predictable performance, high-throughput workloads, uptime SLAs, and business-critical traffic.

product.name: Streams
product.description: A blockchain data pipeline for ingesting live events, applying filters and transformations, handling reorganizations, and delivering historical or real-time data to external destinations.

product.name: SQL Explorer
product.description: A SQL interface for querying indexed blockchain data, including more than 500 billion rows of Hyperliquid trading data through a dashboard or REST API.

product.name: Swap API
product.description: An API for integrating token-swap execution across swap providers, with managed routing and transaction delivery for production trading applications.

product.name: Solana gRPC
product.description: A low-latency gRPC service for streaming Solana blockchain data, including transactions and other events for latency-sensitive applications.
